subject: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood
messages:
From: Claire Chen <c.chen@summithealthtech.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@summithealthtech.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team reviewed the proposal and we have two asks before we can move to a formal PO: 
1) Include the premium onboarding package (dedicated success manager + 4-week integration sprint) as part of year-one with a one-time onboarding credit applied to professional services fees.
2) Confirm that Redwood will deliver the custom connector to our EHR (Epic) — we need development and an integration QA window included in the SOW.

We are prepared to sign fast but need pricing and a final SOW that reflects the above. Attaching our internal RFP note for context.

Attachments: Summit_RFP_notes.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Claire
Claire Chen
Head of Integrations, Summit HealthTech

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <c.chen@summithealthtech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear asks and the RFP note. We can absolutely include the premium onboarding package and scope a custom Epic connector. A couple of operational details before we finalize pricing:

- The Epic connector will be scoped as a one-off professional services deliverable (dev + QA + support for first 90 days). Neha, can you estimate the engineering days and QA window?
- Rishi, I know you have margin constraints; can you run a quick pricing with a one-time onboarding credit applied to PS fees (client requests a credit to reduce upfront fees).

I’ve attached a draft SOW that includes a placeholder for the connector scope and a proposed launch playbook. If you can confirm the acceptance criteria for Epic integration (data types, endpoints, sandbox access timeline), we’ll lock hours and pricing this week.

Attachments: SOW_Summit_v1.3.pdf (draft SOW, pdf)

Proposed next step: quick 30-min call Thursday to align on acceptance criteria and timeline.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Claire Chen <c.chen@summithealthtech.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood — Requesting approval for concession

Team — flagging an escalation to finance/legal for approval. Summit is strategic in our Midwest health vertical and this is an expansion opportunity that could unlock three enterprise seats across their provider network. Summary of concession request: 

- Offer: Premium onboarding (as described) + custom Epic connector dev.
- Commercial ask from the customer: 30% one-time credit on PS fees for year one (they want credit applied at signing). They are still signing full ARR for hosted inference.
- Impact: Estimated $73k PS list, $51k net after credit. Gross margin delta on PS line ~ -40% for year one; platform ARR remains intact.

I recommend we approve a one-time onboarding credit (not a recurring discount) to accelerate close. Requesting an exec-level exception to approve the 30% credit and to allow Redwood to own the connector IP with a standard implementation transfer back to Summit after the 90-day ownership window.

Attached is a quick calc for revenue impact and the draft SOW (with placeholder pricing).

Attachments: discount_calc.xlsx, SOW_Summit_v1.3.pdf

Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood — Requesting approval for concession

Rishi / team — I reviewed the numbers. Approve the one-time onboarding credit at 30% on PS fees under these conditions: 

1) The credit is one-time and non-recurring; it should not be applied to any future maintenance or renewal fees.
2) The SOW must clearly state Redwood retains the right to the connector code for the first 90 days for support and fixes; after that, ownership transfers with an acceptance sign-off.
3) Deal must close with minimum first-year ARR of $225k (platform + support) and payment terms Net30.

If legal (Karthik) signs off on IP/indemnity language, finance will record the credit as a sales concession (deal_id ORN-2025-437) and we can proceed. Jonas

Jonas Weber
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Claire Chen <c.chen@summithealthtech.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood — Requesting approval for concession

Marking up the SOW and IP clauses now. High-level legal checks: 
- We can accept the 90-day launch ownership window for the connector, but we need an explicit acceptance sign-off checklist and a limited warranty clause for the first 90 days.
- Add a narrow indemnity carve-out for third-party EHR connector liabilities and require Summit to provide sandbox access and data mapping.
- The onboarding credit must be a one-time line item in the SOW and called out in the invoice schedule (so finance can tag it properly).

Attaching a redline for the SOW with the required language. Please review and incorporate prior to sending to Claire.

Attachments: redline_SOW.docx, Security_Q_A.xlsx

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <c.chen@summithealthtech.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@summithealthtech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and launch plan — Summit HealthTech / Redwood

Claire / Julian — thanks for your patience. Per our internal approvals: 

- Finance (Jonas) has approved a one-time 30% onboarding credit on PS fees, conditional on minimum first-year ARR $225k and Net30 payment terms.
- Legal (Karthik) has provided redlines; we will include a 90-day Redwood ownership window for the connector with a clearly defined acceptance checklist and limited warranty.
- Neha and the delivery team will scope the Epic connector hours and confirm the QA window on the kickoff call.

Next steps: I’ve attached the redlined SOW and the updated draft that includes the one-time credit line. Can we schedule the kickoff Monday 5/24 at 10:00 AM PT to confirm sandbox access, acceptance criteria, and timeline? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a final DocSend link to the updated SOW + invoice schedule.

Attachments: SOW_Summit_v1.3.pdf (updated with credit line), redline_SOW.docx
Links: https://docsend.com/view/summit-launch-playbook, https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ORN-2025-437

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
